scripts.check: node scripts/build-site.mjs --check && for f in *.user.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node tests/install.test.mjs && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node tests/live.test.mjs && npm run test:signed-in -s
scripts.test:signed-in: npm run build && for f in tests/signed-in/*.test.mjs; do echo "# $f"; PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node "$f" || exit 1; done
